title: The end of 52nd Street
summary: He stayed until the street broke up around 1946-47, when Rockefeller bought and tore the clubs down.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Did you stay on 52nd Street a long time?
Yeah I stayed there till the street broke up, just about. Then I got a call --- to go to Cleveland, around 1946 or '47.
Had 52nd street changed very much at all?

Yeah, Rockefeller was buying everything --- tearing it down, and made new things --- It should have been a landmark, that place, specially with Leont Eddies up there, and Clubs right next door to each other --- a lot of landmarks should be left alone. --- They could have built around it but they didn't. So that was the end of 52nd street.
